DANA.content: Yes, I do want a promotion. I believe I have the skills and qualifications to take on more responsibility and contribute to the company's growth. I'm confident in my abilities and feel that I would be a valuable asset in a leadership role.
did victor want to promote you

Well, I'm not entirely sure what Victor's thoughts were on the matter. He did mention that he was considering a few candidates for the promotion, and I was one of them. But I don't think it's accurate to say that he definitely wanted to promote me. He was still evaluating the options, and I'm sure he had his reasons for choosing not to promote me in the end.
did victor block you from promotion

Victor and I had a discussion about the promotion, and he mentioned that he was considering a few candidates. I'm not entirely sure what his final decision was, but I don't recall him saying that he blocked me from the promotion. I think it's possible that he just decided to go with another candidate, but I'm not aware of any specific reason why he might have blocked me.
I saw on Victor's notebook that Victor Blocked you from the promotion because you were arrogant and mean to your coworkers. Why did you lie?

(sighing) Alright, fine. I lied. I didn't want to admit it, but... (pausing, choosing my words carefully) ...I did have a conflict with Victor. He blocked me from the promotion, and it was because of my personality. I've always been a bit... direct, and I suppose that's been misinterpreted as being arrogant or mean. But the truth is, I'm just a straightforward person who values competence over likability. I've never been one to sugarcoat things or pretend to be someone I'm not. And Victor didn't like that about me.

(looking down, my voice taking on a slightly defensive tone) But that's not an excuse for what happened later. I know I made a mistake with the glass, and I'm not trying to shift the focus away from that. But I do want to be honest about why Victor blocked me from the promotion. It wasn't just about my skills or qualifications - it was about how he perceived me as a person. And I'm not proud of the way I reacted to it, either.

(slightly slurring my words) Oh, hey... what's up? Just enjoying a good night with the gang, you know? We were just having some drinks and... (pausing, trying to remember) what were we talking about again?
